title: HTTP/3 RFC 9114 Large Body Completion Recovery Work Item
summary: Recover managed HTTP/3 large response and upload correctness before using ProtocolLab large-body rows as performance evidence.
planned_changes:
- Add focused repeated 64KB and 1MB HTTP/3 response tests that assert exact body length and clean completion.
- Keep negative content-length and malformed body framing failures visible.
- Fix the smallest verified HTTP/3 response-tail or QUIC final stream write defect.
- Preserve ProtocolLab failed and invalid rows; do not change harness semantics to improve Incursa results.
- Record before/after local benchmark and focused test evidence in the verification artifact.
verification_plan: Run focused HTTP/3 minimal server/client tests, the REQ-QUIC-API-0010 EOF guardrail tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene. After correctness is green, rerun the documented ProtocolLab h3-local-v1-comparison rows and focused HTTP/3 allocation benchmarks as diagnostic evidence.
out_of_scope: Raw QUIC multiplex and duplex throughput tuning.
completion_notes: The transport retry path now retries only owned blocked writes and empty FIN completions, so caller-owned data-carrying writes cannot be replaced by premature empty STREAM/FIN frames before their original stream-action event is processed. Focused HTTP/3 tests now include repeated 64KB and 1MB response completion checks plus the existing large-upload and API EOF guardrails.
